# Code reused from cargo-rbe

Source: the user's `cargo-rbe` project (github.com/Orphis/cargo-rbe), commit
`a22f3610b45522741860a713139c152449c21042`, license MIT OR Apache-2.0.
The cargo-rbe repository itself was not modified.

## rbe-client (copied)

`crates/rbe-client` → `rbe-client/`: REAPI v2 client (Capabilities,
FindMissingBlobs, BatchUpdateBlobs/BatchReadBlobs, ByteStream read/write with
zstd when offered, ActionCache get/update, Execute, `RequestMetadata` per
action) and the Merkle `InputTree` builder.

Local changes:

- `ConnectOptions::headers` / `Client::with_headers`: extra gRPC headers on
  every call (`--remote_header=K=V`).
- `ConnectOptions::authority_override`: the name the server's certificate
  is checked against, instead of the endpoint's host
  (`--tls_authority_override`).
- The process-wide `static FILE_DIGESTS` cache was removed (ninja-rs has no
  global state). `file_digest` takes an optional `&dyn DigestCache`; the
  cache key is the symlink-resolved path, so many links to one file are
  hashed once. `MemDigestCache` is provided, with `entries()` for
  persistence. `InputTree::add_file_cached` / `add_dir_cached` /
  `add_file_with_digest` / `contains` were added.
- `Cargo.toml` uses the ninja-rs workspace dependencies; a Bazel
  `BUILD.bazel` was added; an unused-variable warning on Windows was fixed.
- `upload_blobs` fails with `MissingRemoteBlobs` (the local paths) when
  blobs that only existed in the CAS (`BlobSource::Remote`) are gone, for
  action rewinding; `InputTree::digests` lists every input with its
  digest (for the execution log).
- Content-defined chunking (`chunking.rs`: FastCDC 2020 through the
  `fastcdc` crate, and the server's split/splice support from its
  capabilities); `Client::split_blob` / `splice_blob` (`GetChunkMapping` /
  `RegisterChunkMapping` from RE API v2.13, `SplitBlob` / `SpliceBlob`
  before); `upload_blobs` uploads large blobs as their missing chunks and
  splices them when the server supports it, and returns the bytes sent.
- `valid_hash` / `valid_digest`: digests a server gives (chunk lists too)
  are checked to be 64 lowercase hex digits and a size of at least 0
  before they name files.
- `connect_channel` bounds connecting (`CONNECT_TIMEOUT`, 20 s, the TLS
  handshake included, on reconnections too); a server that never answered
  isn't called again (`Client::retrying`); a broken `Execute`/`WaitExecution`
  stream that brought an update of the operation starts the retry count
  over.
- `upload_blobs` sends up to 16 batches and ByteStream writes at once
  (`UPLOADS`); reads are bounded to 32 in flight for all clones
  (`MAX_READS`), decompressed and hashed on blocking threads;
  `read_blob_to_file` writes a blob to a file as it arrives, checked
  against its digest, never whole in memory.

## rbe-bes (copied)

`crates/rbe-bes` â†’ `rbe-bes/`: the Build Event Service client (ordered
`PublishBuildToolEventStream` with acks, retries and lifecycle events) and
a builder for valid BEP streams, with the vendored googleapis and Bazel
protos. Code is generated by `build.rs` with `protox` and
`tonic-prost-build` (no system protoc); under Bazel through
`cargo_build_script`, with the protos as its data.

Local changes:

- `BesConfig::headers`: extra gRPC headers on every call (`--bes_header`).
- `BesConfig::trace` switches the upload tracing on (`NINJA_RS_BES_DEBUG=1`),
  instead of cargo-rbe's `CARGO_RBE_BES_DEBUG` environment variable. The
  rest of `uploader.rs` follows cargo-rbe commit
  `ec02207fc3a9ee282f13820983b1ee5c493a51ec`.
- `Cargo.toml` uses the ninja-rs workspace dependencies; a Bazel
  `BUILD.bazel` was added.
- `BesUploader::connecting` connects in the background task (`is_closed`
  tells a failed upload); the lifecycle start events go alongside the
  stream (`check_preceding_lifecycle_events_present` is false); every call
  has a deadline (`BesConfig::rpc_timeout`, 15 s); a backend that never
  answered isn't called again.

## Not copied (yet)
- `rbe-exec` (worker-side helper that substitutes an `@EXECROOT@` token and
  scrubs it from outputs): ninja-rs rewrites absolute paths to paths relative
  to the working directory instead, which works for C/C++ compilers without
  a helper binary on the worker. It remains the fallback design for tools
  that require absolute paths (see docs/paths.md).
- `rbe-rustc`: its `Mapper` (local prefix → exec-root mapping with path
  boundary checks) inspired `ninja-remote/src/paths.rs`; the rustc-specific
  layout isn't applicable.
